objective: Test whether reducing Monte Carlo variance with K leave-one-out infinigram samples per training position makes weak infinigram distillation useful.
hypothesis: K in {16, 32, 64} supplies a materially denser estimate of the teacher cross-entropy, while b below the prior K=1 optimum avoids over-weighting an imperfect corpus teacher.

objective_definition.formula: (1 - b) * CE(ground_truth, model) + b * mean_j CE(sample_j, model)
objective_definition.sampling: K iid draws with replacement from the exact leave-one-occurrence-out infinite-gram distribution at each position
objective_definition.variance: The sampled teacher term is unbiased; conditional Monte Carlo variance decreases as 1/K.
objective_definition.coupling: For a fixed seed and position, K=16 is a prefix of K=32, which is a prefix of K=64.
objective_definition.validation: Canonical validation is ground-truth cross-entropy only.

grid.selection_rule: Run every cell to the complete 5-TPP endpoint; rank by canonical validation loss and compare with the reused dense and K=1 controls.

systems_gate.acceptance: Every requested K compiles, fits, and remains within a 20% training-throughput reduction from K=1.

k32.trajectory_check: training.riglog and diagnostics.riglog are byte-identical across the two launches

implementation.host_query: Search/backoff/count once per position, then draw K times from one adjusted continuation distribution.
implementation.forward_loss: One tiled vocabulary log-normalizer plus K embedding-row target logits accumulated one at a time.
implementation.backward_loss: The tiled vocabulary loop computes softmax and ground-truth terms; teacher corrections use bounded chunks of eight gathered rows and sparse embedding-row scatter-adds, O(KD).

launch_policy: Launch all nine cells sequentially in increasing K and then increasing b. Do not select, retry, or stop based on intermediate quality observations.
stopping_rule: Every cell runs through all 4709 optimizer steps. A systems failure stops the queue for inspection; a scientific outcome does not.
